# Contributing

This repo is an extracted, standalone version of the onboarding layer
from [DeCleanup Network](https://github.com/DeCleanup-Network/decleanup-main-celo).

The production source of truth is currently in `lib/client-wallet`,
`lib/smart-account`, and `lib/paymaster` in the main app repo.

If you are adapting this for a new chain or auth provider, please open
an issue describing your use case. We want to know what communities
are building with this.
